actions.action: Check soil moisture 2-3 inches deep before watering
If no drainage, move plant into nursery pot with holes inside decorative pot
Place in bright indirect light away from drafts and radiators
If new leaves keep yellowing or stem softens, check roots for rot
Snip off yellow leaf once fully yellow
